# Parked at solution until SEEN-100 delivers

Decision by the founder, 24 September 2026: fix the question before working the tickets it will judge.
SEEN-096, SEEN-098 and SEEN-099 are all integration tickets, and each has the shape that dropped this
ticket's clarify score to 0.46 when it was written down honestly.

The journal stops at the solution stage with the clarify record accepted, its `clarified` answer
carrying the founder's override at record 7 beside Jev's 0.67. Resuming needs nothing beyond
`harness status SEEN-096`, which will say solution.

What travels with it: the baseline captured at record 2 belongs to SEEN-099 now, and the note at
record 6 is the evidence SEEN-100 was opened on.
